picks.title: 메디컬에이아이, 심전도 기반 심부전 진단 보조 AI 'AiTiALVSD' 美 FDA 허가 획득
picks.excerpt: 메디컬에이아이의 심전도 기반 좌심실 수축기능부전(심부전) 진단 보조 소프트웨어 'AiTiALVSD'가 미국 FDA 허가를 받았다.
picks.rationale: A concrete FDA clearance for an ECG-based heart-failure detection SaMD, so it reaches regulators and clinicians directly. The full URL (idxno=3014060) does not appear in the history.

picks.title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient-Physician Communication: The AI-INFOCARE Randomized Controlled Trial
picks.excerpt: A randomized trial tested whether AI-generated, quality-checked lay-language summaries of patients' medical documents, given before the visit, change consultation time and patient-physician communication.
picks.rationale: An RCT on giving patients AI lay-language summaries before the visit, with consultation time and communication as outcomes. It is a different study and intervention from the 10-11 LLM pre-consultation trial and the 10-18 oncology usability study.

picks.title: HPI: Evidence contradicts broad claims about AI, radiology workforce
picks.excerpt: The ACR's Harvey L. Neiman Health Policy Institute says claims that AI has reduced the need for radiologists are contradicted by rising imaging volumes, projected 17-27% demand growth by 2055 and climbing radiologist workloads.
picks.rationale: An ACR Neiman Health Policy Institute analysis that pushes back on the claim that AI replaces radiologists, a workforce question that matters to clinicians and health systems. Nothing comparable has been published.

picks.title: A generalizable deep learning model for predicting opioid use disorder using language modeling for cross-EHR data harmonization
picks.excerpt: OUD-REY is a deep learning model that uses longitudinal EHR data from the All of Us program, harmonized across record systems with language modeling, to predict a patient's one-year risk of opioid use disorder.
picks.rationale: OUD-REY predicts one-year opioid use disorder risk from All of Us EHR data harmonized across record systems. It targets a specific disease, is new research, and has nothing in common with the 10-13 data-privacy match beyond wording.

picks.title: 루닛, 난소암·방광암 AI 연구 발표…면역항암 치료반응 탐색
picks.excerpt: 루닛이 SITC 2026에서 AI 바이오마커 플랫폼 루닛 스코프로 난소암(랩콥 공동)과 방광암의 면역항암 치료 반응을 탐색한 연구초록 2편을 발표한다.
picks.rationale: Lunit's SITC 2026 abstracts on predicting immunotherapy response in ovarian and bladder cancer with Lunit SCOPE. These are specific cancers with a treatment-response angle, Lunit has not appeared in the 30-day history, and the pick adds a fifth outlet.
